tagline: Fridays on the Farm: Creating Community at Henry’s Family Farm
description: It looks like it was sold in 2021 and never reopened. is a small berry farm in Henry, TN. It grows Blueberries, with picking through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
